Starting to get 50% (or more) of my daily work done via iMessage.

I pinned text threads with my Dot and my Instinct, and any time I need to get a business task done I just text my Dot.

Any time I need to get personal work done I text my Instinct.

So much of working with AI revolves around personal preference and I much prefer to work inside the platform I already use most.

I found that when I removed all friction of having to jump between platforms (Slack, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) I'm able to get work done much quicker.

note_tweet.text:
None of the 39 AI features we track changed EU status this week. Here's where the big ones stand on Friday 30 October.

Siri AI gained French, Spanish and Portuguese on 26 October with Apple's 27.2 updates. The same Apple note says it is "currently unavailable in the EU in iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS." So it now speaks the language of Paris, Madrid and Lisbon, just not on an iPhone there.

ChatGPT dots: OpenAI's help page, updated this week, still rolls them out to Pro users "in markets excluding the European Economic Area, Switzerland, and the UK." Business Premium gets them in supported regions.

Gemini tasks (the feature formerly called Spark) are available "except in the European Economic Area, Nigeria, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom." They also need Personal Intelligence switched on, which has the same exclusion.

Claude Duet is still a US-only research preview, for Pro and Max users with a waitlist invite.

Our count today: 16 of 39 features fully available in the EU, 6 partly, 14 not at all, 3 unclear.
